blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Batangas Rep. Gerville Luistro, lead public prosecutor for the impeachment trial, reminded Vice President Sara Duterte’s camp that the issues surrounding banana chip manufacturer Cale88 Foods Corporation are just one part of a series of allegations by the prosecution. In an ambush interview, Luistro noted that the report of financial forensic analyst Atty. Alexander Cabrera involved more than Cale88 and its financial transactions, as there are other issues mentioned — most importantly, the alleged P817 million that Duterte supposedly omitted from her Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN).
